fee_notes: Uniform $49,000 fee; non-refundable. $1,000 Application Fee credited against it. Renewal franchisees pay a renewal fee instead of initial fee. OEP (equipment package) of $28,000 paid separately on signing.
raw_excerpt: When you sign the Franchise Agreement, you must pay to us a non-refundable initial Franchise Fee ("Franchise Fee") in the amount of $49,000. The initial franchise fee is due in full at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement.
